control_aggregation.analysis_policy: Separate reversible unsecured Control from permanent Secured state, while also retaining their combined ownership/control measure.
control_aggregation.game_rule_relationship: A Secured Supply Point is Controlled by its owner.
control_aggregation.share_denominator: all 24 game turns for lifecycle/site summaries and all 8 phase turns for phase summaries

neutral_and_contest.is_contested: both players have at least one Piece at turn end, regardless of which player Controls the unresolved point
neutral_and_contest.is_neutral: state_at_turn_end equals 0, including an empty point

objective_coverage.definition: distinct adjacent Objectives actually supplied divided by the Supply Point's number of adjacent Objectives

securable_opportunity.eventual_conversion_rate: ever-securable player-sites eventually Secured divided by ever-securable player-sites
securable_opportunity.same_turn_take_rate: securing events divided by repeated legal opportunities

spatial_categories.corner: four Supply Points with row and column both on the boundary
spatial_categories.edge: twelve non-corner Supply Points on the boundary
spatial_categories.s22_comparison: S22 versus the other eight interior Supply Points
